_comment: AbleGauge bundled rules-engine config. Field names match docs/able-guard/product.md §3 exactly (rule_name, value, effective_from, effective_to, jurisdiction, program, official_source, source_confidence, last_verified, implementation_note). Shape mirrors projects/able-guard-web/data/rules.json (current_year + years block) so both platforms can eventually share one hosted config - see decisions.md. Every value traces to docs/able-guard/rules-factcheck.md; never cite IRS.gov (confirmed stale on 2026 figures).

rules.implementation_note: Page content reflects current-year 2026 figures despite the URL slug. IRS.gov is stale (still shows 2025's $19,000) - do not cite IRS.gov as source.

Lesser-of test: additional room = min(compensation, this cap). Figure tracks the 1-person federal poverty line per ABLE NRC's stated mechanism; the underlying poverty-line arithmetic itself was not independently re-derived - do not present the derivation as re-verified, only the resulting figure and the lesser-of rule.

POMS SI 01130.740: first $100,000 in an ABLE account is excluded from SSI countable resources. Only the amount EXCEEDING $100,000 counts as a resource. Never compare the raw ABLE balance to this figure as a cliff - see ssi_resource_limit for the actual comparison.

Standard individual SSI resource limit. Only the individual limit is supported at MVP - couple-filing has a different limit, not independently re-verified; app copy must tell couple-filing users to check current SSA guidance.
Secondary-confirmed - direct fetch of calable.ca.gov was blocked (403) during fact-check; figure corroborated via search of the program's own published content.
Secondary-confirmed - direct PDF fetch of ABLEnow's Program Description returned unreadable encoded text; figure corroborated via search referencing that same official document.

Could not be independently confirmed from ableunited.com directly (homepage fetch succeeded but did not state a figure); sourced from a secondary aggregator. UI must show the 'Unconfirmed' qualifier and link out to ableunited.com - never present as a plain fact.

Direct fetch of stableaccount.com was blocked (403); figure came from a search snippet of uncertain vintage. Do NOT show any STABLE contribution-limit figures anywhere - the accompanying $16,000/$12,880 figures found alongside this number are stale/pre-2026 and conflict with the confirmed 2026 national figures. This row is ONLY the plan maximum.
